title: Claude will apply invisible watermarks to AI text and images
summary: These updates are a future commitment rather than something that will go into effect immediately. The machine-readable marks will be applied globally to supported Claude models, including Claude Platform (API), Claude, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Claude Tag.
